// diagnostic

E0622

A module binding's value must be a literal

What

A module binding's value must be a literal

Why

A module constant is folded once while building, so its value must be literal data: numbers, text, typed literals, and enum cases. A mutable or `#Persist` module global is runtime storage initialized from a scalar literal.

Fix

Write the value as literal data, such as a struct literal whose fields are literals, or compute it inside a function.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0622: tests/ui/module_array_computed_element.stderr.

Error [E0622]: A module binding's value must be a literal
  --> tests/ui/module_array_computed_element.jet:1:14
    |
  1 | BAD_TABLE :: [Int]{1 + 2}
    |              ^^^^^^^^^^^^
 Why: A module constant is folded once while building, so its value must be literal data: numbers, text, typed literals, and enum cases
 Fix: Write the value as literal data, such as `RGB{r: U8{0}, g: U8{0}, b: U8{0}}`, prepare it while building with `NAME :: prep { value }`, or compute it inside a function
